title: Console incident-mode: missing series (metric tombstone) during high-throughput rollbacks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: During a high-throughput deployment rollback window (2025-11-14 incident), multiple customers reported missing metric series and empty live panels in the Redwood Console. The problem manifested across Hosted and Dedicated tenants and was most visible for time-series with frequent rollbacks. This ticket tracked investigation, remediation, rollout, and verification for the fix that prevents metric tombstones from being silently dropped and ensures console panels recover gracefully after ingestion topology changes.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy canary change to metric-aggregator that includes series dedup heuristics. 2) Trigger a rapid deploy/rollback cycle while synthetic load generator is active for user-level metrics. 3) Open Console live panel for affected tenant and observe missing series or zeroed panels for 5-15 minutes. 4) Query raw ingestion topic shows tombstone messages for series keys that the console query layer previously ignored.
root_cause: The aggregator produced tombstone messages for series keys during fast rollbacks. The timeline: tombstone messages were written to the ingestion topic, the metrics indexer treated tombstones as deletes and removed series from the compressed index, while the Console panel cache relied on presence in the index and did not fallback to re-query raw time-series on empty results. Additionally, an optimization in the console that filtered out 'null' series during graph rendering suppressed any UI indicator that series had been deleted. The combination of silent tombstone deletion + stale panel cache produced the observed gaps.
mitigation: Short-term mitigation applied during the incident: 1) Disable the aggressive tombstone write path in aggregator (hotfix) to stop new deletions; 2) Invalidate console panel caches for affected customers via an admin script so panels re-query raw storage; 3) Communication: sent status updates to impacted customers and opened support tickets. Mitigations restored visibility in ~30-45 minutes for most tenants.
fix_summary: Implemented multi-part fix: (A) In ingestion/runtime: change tombstone semantics so that tombstones write an explicit 'tombstone-meta' record instead of a hard delete; indexing now retains a lightweight series footprint and marks it as deleted (so UI can present a tombstone indicator). (B) Console: add retry logic for empty panel queries and ensure panel cache invalidation is triggered on topology/ingestion rollbacks. (C) Added end-to-end tests that simulate rapid deploy/rollback load to ensure no silent loss of series and that panels surface tombstone/restore state.
deploy_plan:
- Deploy ingestion change to staging and run synthetic rollback scenario (2h)
- Canary to 10% hosted traffic + 2 dedicated customers (4h)
- Monitor error budget/latency and console panel resolution for 24h
- Ramp to 100% hosted then apply config for Dedicated fleet, coordinate with private customers for on-prem patches
- Post-deploy: run runbook validation and mark runtime-1.19 and console-2025.11 releases
verification: Acceptance criteria: (1) No empty live panels reported by canary tenants under rollback simulation; (2) Tombstone events are surfaced in console UI as 'deleted series' badge; (3) e2e test suite passes in CI for rapid-deploy scenarios. Verified against staging and canary customers for 48h with zero regressions.
